about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Sport HSE ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover Sport HSE has been part of the Range Rover Sport range since 2005, and across its three generations has used several different engines — from the TDV6 and SDV6 diesel V6s of the L320 and L494 generations, through to today's Ingenium I6 units and BMW-sourced V8s on the current L461 platform. The HSE designation is a trim level that has been offered across all generations, rather than a specific engine family — which means the engine in your HSE depends entirely on which generation and model year you own. The full breakdown by engine code is below.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace TDV6, SDV6, TDV8, SDV8 (L320/L494), Ingenium AJ300D, AJ300P, BMW N63 (L461) engines for every Range Rover Sport HSE on the road.

codes.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover Sport HSE ENGINE

cards.body: 3.0-litre V6 diesels fitted to the Range Rover Sport HSE from 2005 to 2022. Known for timing chain tensioner wear, injector seal leaks and crankshaft bearing failure risk — see the callout above. We replace timing chains, tensioners, injector seals, EGR components and gaskets as standard on every rebuild.
cards.cta: Check Your TDV6 / SDV6 Range Rover Sport HSE

cards.body: 4.4-litre V8 diesels fitted across the same L320 and L494 generations. Shares the same timing chain pattern as the TDV6/SDV6 family. We replace timing chains, injector seals, EGR components and gaskets as standard.
cards.cta: Check Your TDV8 / SDV8 Range Rover Sport HSE

cards.body: 3.0-litre inline-six diesel mild-hybrid fitted from 2022. A newer design with improved reliability. The DC-DC converter caveat associated with Ingenium MHEV systems is flagged but not independently confirmed for the Range Rover Sport specifically.
cards.cta: Check Your Ingenium AJ300D Range Rover Sport HSE

cards.body: 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid fitted from 2022. Generally regarded as more reliable than earlier diesel V6s. The same DC-DC converter caveat applies, pending confirmation.
cards.cta: Check Your Ingenium AJ300P Range Rover Sport HSE

cards.body: 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8 from BMW, fitted from 2022. Inherited from the Range Rover N63/S68 split via platform-sharing — not independently re-verified for Sport specifically, but a low-risk inference given the shared MLA-Flex platform. The N63 hot-vee pattern applies.
cards.cta: Check Your BMW N63 Range Rover Sport HSE

compatibility.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover Sport HSE ENGINE
compatibility.intro: Because the Range Rover Sport HSE spans three generations and multiple distinct engine families, fitting the wrong replacement — or assuming parts are interchangeable between a TDV6 and an Ingenium engine — risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

badge.title: TDV6, SDV6, TDV8, SDV8 (L320/L494), Ingenium AJ300D, AJ300P, BMW N63 (L461)

points.text: Your exact engine code (TDV6, SDV6, TDV8, SDV8 (L320/L494), Ingenium AJ300D, AJ300P, BMW N63 (L461)) via registration or VIN
Whether your build falls in the early production period (2019-2020) for injector fault coverage

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Defender quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
